about.titel: A PORTFOLIO... SUCH A CHARMING WAY TO MAKE IT ALL ABOUT YOURSELF, ISN’T IT?
about.lead: HI! I AM CARLIJN CORPORAAL. BUT MY NAME IS JUST A NAME. AND MY FACE IS JUST A FACE. SO LET ME GIVE YOU A CHANCE TO REALLY GET TO KNOW ME THROUGH MY WORDS :)
alinea: Behind the face, you'll find a 25-year-old woman who recently graduated from the University of Amsterdam.
People often describe me as social, direct, energetic, enthusiastic, and ambitious, and that last one shows in everything I do.

I have hands-on experience in marketing and brand campaigns at RE/MAX, Hulaaloop, and Reliving, and academically I never really knew when to stop either. After my bachelor's in International Marketing Management, I continued with a pre-master's, then a master's in Business Administration, specializing in Management & Entrepreneurship in Creative Industries.

But what I studied does not really say much about who I am as a person. Creativity does. It runs through my life in more forms than I can count: playing guitar, sewing, crochet, singing, writing, and producing my own songs. In 2022, I co-wrote and co-produced a theater show, performed at the Stadsschouwburg and Martiniplaza in Groningen, where I later played Sandy in Grease. Whether through music, theater, or content, creating stories has always been my way of connecting with people. That is also what draws me to strategy: finding the idea, the insight, or the story that pulls people in.
It is that combination, creative and strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, that I bring into every project I take on. I am currently available from September 2026 for a full-time position.

projecten.impressie: Replica: Your Moment — an expert-guided identity layering system for Maison Margiela's REPLICA, taking the fragrance line from capturing a place to capturing who you are within it.

blokken.p: Maison Margiela is a French fashion house known for its bold, avant-garde approach across haute couture, ready-to-wear, and accessories. Its fragrance line, REPLICA, takes a distinctly storytelling-driven approach to perfume: each fragrance is designed to recreate a specific memory or moment in time, from Jazz Club's late-night atmosphere to Lazy Sunday Morning's quiet calm, turning scent into a vehicle for narrative and emotional recall rather than just an accessory.

Building on that foundation, we developed Replica: Your Moment. A concept that takes REPLICA a step further, from capturing a place to capturing who you are within it. The result is an expert-guided identity layering system: Maison Margiela-designed scent combinations, personalized to mood and personality, that adapt across different moments of the day, supported by both an online and in-store consultation experience.

projecten.impressie: BM Spotlight — a new digital platform and app that repositions a Dutch media trade title from observer to gatekeeper of its industry, uniting creators, media hubs, companies and advertisers in one space.

blokken.p: Broadcast Magazine (BM) is a Dutch trade publication that has covered the international television and radio industry for years.

Unfortunately, the brand was facing the challenge of an aging audience and declining conversions, increasing the need of a way to become relevant to a younger generation. Leading to the introduction of BM Spotlight!

BM Spotlight is a new digital platform and app that unites creators, media hubs, companies, and advertisers in one space, giving BM a renewed identity as the media industry's gatekeeper rather than just its observer. I led the strategic repositioning behind this shift, including the rebranding of the app and website, and developed communication tools for both B2B and B2C engagement.

projecten.impressie: A full repositioning and rebranding for a circular kids-fashion platform: strategic plan, storytelling narrative, brand book and all the visual materials that carry it across social media.

blokken.p: Hulaaloop is a Dutch circular fashion platform where parents can rent high-quality kids' clothing (from brands using organic, GOTS-certified cotton) for each stage of a child's growth, keeping clothing in circulation as long as possible instead of sending it to landfills after a few months of use.

Due to a limited budget, low conversions, and a small customer base, Hulaaloop hired me to drive the brand's repositioning and rebranding, developing a full strategic plan with short- and long-term goals, building a storytelling narrative for the brand, creating a brand book, and translating it all into the visual materials used across social media.

projecten.impressie: Giving a second-hand design-furniture marketplace a digital heartbeat: website, social (45k+ Instagram), Google Analytics, e-mail campaigns, influencer marketing and events — one seamless omnichannel experience.
projecten.resultaat: Maintained and grew a community of 45,000+ Instagram followers with data-driven content and campaigns.

blokken.p: Reliving is a Dutch second-hand marketplace for vintage and design furniture, giving pre-loved pieces a new life instead of ending up in landfills. It connects buyers and sellers of unique, characterful furniture within the growing circular economy movement in home and interior design, where sustainability and individual style go hand in hand.

At Reliving, my role was never just to manage its touchpoints, but to give the brand a digital heartbeat. I maintained the website, oversaw social media activity across platforms, including an Instagram channel with 45k+ followers, and managed Google Analytics to guide decisions during Reliving's rebranding. I orchestrated email marketing campaigns, coordinated influencer marketing initiatives and events, and maintained the brand's collaboration with partner Fonq. All to ensure a seamless, omnichannel marketing experience.

projecten.impressie: I introduced short-form video to RE/MAX Curaçao, turning listings and island lifestyle into scroll-stopping content for TikTok, Instagram and Facebook — concepted, filmed and edited myself, in an intercultural market.
projecten.resultaat: Drove online brand visibility for RE/MAX and PMI Curaçao across multiple channels.

blokken.p: RE/MAX Curaçao had strong listings and island lifestyle to show, but no short-form video presence. In an intercultural market, the brand needed content that could stop the scroll on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.

I introduced short-form video to the office end-to-end: I concepted, filmed and edited the videos myself, turning listings and the island lifestyle into scroll-stopping content, and built a repeatable content approach across TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.
Short-form video became a lasting part of how RE/MAX and PMI Curaçao show up online, driving brand visibility across multiple channels and helping realtors show properties in a fresh, personal way.

projecten.impressie: As co-writer and producer I helped bring an original musical to the stage of the 1,580-seat MartiniPlaza Theater in Groningen — from scripting the story to producing the run.
projecten.beschrijving: Co-writer and producer of the musical Trappelen, performed at the MartiniPlaza Theater.
projecten.resultaat: Over 1,580 seats sold in both September 2021 and March 2022.

blokken.p: Trappelen is an original musical I co-wrote and co-produced for the 1,580-seat MartiniPlaza Theater in Groningen. From the first draft of the story to the final performance, I helped shape a full-scale live production from the ground up.
As co-writer and producer I worked across the whole pipeline: scripting the story, planning the production and coordinating the team that brought it to the stage.

Producing a live show is storytelling under real constraints — budget, planning, a large cast and a hard opening night. It sharpened how I combine creative vision with structured project management, a mix I bring into every campaign I work on.

referenties.relatie: Direct supervisor during my internship at RE/MAX Bonbini Curaçao (2024)
referenties.citaat: What characterized her most was her innovative and proactive attitude: she recognized opportunities, took the initiative, and successfully translated ideas into concrete execution.
brieftekst: In 2024, I worked closely with Carlijn for six months during her internship as a Marketing & Communication Intern at RE/MAX BonBini Curaçao, where I served as her direct supervisor. During this period, I came to know her as an enthusiastic, eager-to-learn, and professional intern who readily took on responsibility and integrated seamlessly into the team.

Carlijn made a valuable contribution to our marketing and communication activities. She was responsible for our social media campaigns and email marketing, and additionally initiated our activities on TikTok and with short-form video. In doing so, she played an important role in strengthening our omnichannel strategy within the local Curaçao market. What characterized her most was her innovative and proactive attitude: she recognized opportunities, took the initiative, and successfully translated ideas into concrete execution.

In addition to her general marketing duties, Carlijn took on an independent project supporting individual real estate agents with their personal branding and visual design. Through this, she contributed to a stronger brand image for both the agents and the agency. She worked independently, communicated clearly, and brought energy and creativity to the team.

Based on our collaboration in 2024, I highly recommend Carlijn for future positions within marketing, communication, or commercial roles. I am convinced that with her proactive mindset, creativity, and sense of responsibility, she will be a valuable asset to any organization.

brieftekst: It is with great pleasure that I recommend Carlijn Corporaal.
In 2023, Carlijn completed an internship within the marketing department at Reliving. During her time with us, she made a valuable contribution to our team and our marketing initiatives.

Carlijn’s responsibilities included supporting our social media content creation. She actively contributed ideas for content formats, angles, and scheduling, and successfully translated creative concepts into concrete posts. In addition, she assisted with our influencer marketing campaigns. Together, we organized an influencer event where Carlijn was involved in both the concept development and the practical execution.

Carlijn also played an important role in the launch of our pop-up store in Utrecht. She supported the organization and execution of the project, demonstrating a strong sense of initiative and responsibility.

Carlijn is a highly enthusiastic and motivated professional. She is a proactive thinker, adapts flexibly to changing circumstances, and works exceptionally well within a team. Her positive energy and commitment made her a valued member of our marketing department.

I highly recommend Carlijn to any organization seeking a driven, eager-to-learn, and dedicated marketing professional. Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
